Estimate the thermal-mismatch strain in an aluminum film bonded to a ceramic substrate that is cooled by 180 K.
Use a coefficient of thermal expansion of 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ for the aluminum film.
Use a coefficient of thermal expansion of 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ for the ceramic substrate.
Compute the mismatch strain as ε = (α_f − α_s) × ΔT = (23×10⁻⁶ − 8×10⁻⁶) × 180 K.
The expected result is ε = 2.7×10⁻³, approximately 0.27%.
Report the mismatch strain in dimensionless strain units with the percentage equivalent.
